description: Lightweight employment dispute truth pack for Trace regression breadth.

documents.name: Performance Review Email
documents.text: 2024-01-12 Manager Elena Park emailed Marcus Benton that his quarterly performance was meeting expectations and that the Atlas rollout was on schedule.

documents.name: HR Complaint Intake
documents.text: 2024-01-19 Marcus Benton reported to HR partner Theo Grant that he was being excluded from Atlas planning meetings after raising overtime concerns.

documents.name: Termination Memo
documents.text: 2024-02-02 Lakeside Analytics terminated Marcus Benton for alleged missed milestones, even though the prior review said the Atlas rollout was on schedule.

documents.name: Slack Export
documents.text: 2024-01-25 Elena Park wrote that Marcus Benton was becoming a problem after his overtime complaint and that leadership should revisit his role.

known_contradictions.claim_a: Marcus Benton was meeting expectations and the Atlas rollout was on schedule.
known_contradictions.claim_b: Lakeside Analytics terminated Marcus Benton for alleged missed milestones.

ambiguities.notes: The Slack export suggests timing and motive but does not alone prove causation.

golden_questions.question: What evidence supports Marcus Benton's retaliation theory?
What conflicts exist in the performance rationale?

memo_topics.issue: Whether Lakeside terminated Marcus Benton for performance or retaliation
